newsitem.title: TURKEY: Four Turk soldiers dead in Iraq - security sources.
newsitem.headline: Four Turk soldiers dead in Iraq - security sources.

text.p: Four Turkish soldiers have been killed in a cross-border operation into northern Iraq against separatist rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK), Turkish security sources said on Thursday.

The security officials said that the soldiers had been killed in the early hours of the operation, which began before dawn on Wednesday. Earlier, state-run Anatolian news agency said 30 rebel Kurds had also died.
